relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.evidence: He was the son of Franciszek Rawita-Gawroński (a historian, writer and a columnist of the nationalistic press)

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.evidence: He graduated in Linguistics from the University of Lwów and University of Leipzig (1902–1906).

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.evidence: In 1906, Gawroński defended his doctoral thesis, Sprachliche Untersuchungen über das Mr.cchakat.ika und das Daśakumāracarita, at the University of Leipzig

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.role: assistant professor in the Department of Indo-European Linguistics
relations.evidence: became assistant professor in the Department of Indo-European Linguistics at the Jagiellonian University.

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.evidence: In 1912 he completed his Habilitationschrift Am Rande des Mr.cchakat.ika and was promoted to the rank of associate professor.

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.role: chair in the Department of Sanskrit Philology
relations.evidence: In the years 1916-1917 he took the chair in the Department of Sanskrit Philology at the Jagiellonian University.

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.role: full professor and Head of the Department of Contrastive Linguistics
relations.evidence: From 1917 full professor and Head of the Department of Contrastive Linguistics at the University of Lwów.

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.evidence: one of the founders of the Polish Linguistic Society (1925).

relations.subject: Andrzej Gawroński
relations.object: Institute of Oriental Studies at the University of Lwów
relations.evidence: Also, he initiated the activity of the “Eastern Library” at the Ossolinski National Institute in Lwów and the “Annual of Oriental Studies” and the Institute of Oriental Studies at the University of Lwów.
